name: Technotronix
old_description: AS9100/ISO 9001 custom cable and wire harness assemblies (secondary to PCB assembly)
about:
Technotronix operates from Anaheim, California, where it was founded in 1981. The company has grown over more than four decades into a full-service printed circuit board manufacturer serving OEMs, startups, and enterprises across multiple sectors.

The company provides end-to-end PCB services including layout, fabrication, assembly (through-hole, surface-mount, and mixed technology), box build, cable and wire harness assembly, and metal fabrication. It works with rigid, flexible, and metal-core substrates and places components ranging from fine-pitch BGAs and QFPs down to 0201 packages. Production spans prototype runs through high-volume in-line manufacturing, supported by Mycronic 200 placement machines, Heller reflow systems, wave soldering, and a BGA rework station. Quality inspection uses CRX-100 X-ray, benchtop AOI, and manual checks.

Technotronix serves the automotive, electronics, telecommunications, medical, renewable energy, and defense industries. Its medical portfolio includes ECG recorders, bio-analytical instruments, dialysis equipment, and hearing aids. The company also supports electric vehicle prototyping and LED lighting projects, working with OEMs, startups, and larger enterprises that require scalable, cost-effective manufacturing.

The company emphasizes flexibility, offering no minimum order quantities, 24-hour prototype assembly turnaround, and both kitted and turnkey options. It holds ISO 9001:2015, AS9100 Rev. D, and ANAB ISO/IEC 17021 accreditations, and maintains a global vendor network to meet time-critical demands. Technotronix states that customer relations, integrity, and real-time quality inspection differentiate its service.
